title: •Despair
caption: •Despair (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. During your battle phase, while you have a frozen captive, opponent’s cards may not move. At same site as Jabba’s Prize, opponent’s cards are deploy +1 and your Force drains are +2. My Favorite Decoration may not be placed out of play. {alter}
lore: The carbonite froze more than just Han’s body.
copyright: TM & © 1997 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1997 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Printed base is an IMMEDIATE EFFECT; slip banner reads EFFECT, no grabber box → grabber false. ERRATA: the sheet cover says card #32 received errata on 14 September 2007 — this transcription is what this Remaster sheet prints (the stub's game_text_note calls it post-errata); the pre-errata wording is not on this sheet. Red circle-slash A at the end → {alter}. Curly apostrophes in opponent’s (twice) and Jabba’s. The slip's bottom strip prints a small gold/bronze sphere between the caption and the number (an errata marker, as vs5/49). Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophe in Han’s (wiki straight). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1997 (Cloud City) not legible. Modern: V1-D-despair.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 1 remake); VB2 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
